task: Add an always-redact detector, ory-token, for the Ory session token and the Ory OAuth2 access, refresh and authorization-code tokens, with synthetic fixtures for every positive, twin and benign sibling below.

positives.description: Prefix ory_st_ followed by exactly 32 characters of [A-Za-z0-9] (39 bytes total). Finding type ory_session_token.

Prefix ory_at_, ory_rt_ or ory_ac_, then a key part of at least 43 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-], one '.', then a signature of exactly 43 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. A wider key part (44 or 48 bytes) still matches. Finding type ory_oauth2_token.
Each shape is claimed bare and in an X-Session-Token header, an Authorization Bearer header, an ORY_ACCESS_TOKEN assignment, a constructor argument and an OAuth2 token response JSON.

exclusions.description: ory_pat_, ory_apikey_ and ory_wak_ admin keys get no type and no claim.
exclusions.reason: No provider source gives a body length or alphabet; issuance-gated and tracked separately.
A flow token passed in a logout URL, not an account credential; out of the first contract.

exclusions.description: JWT access tokens, which carry no Ory prefix.
exclusions.reason: They stay with the jwt detector.

exclusions.description: Enterprise custom OAuth2 prefixes and pre-2023 unprefixed session tokens.

twins.description: ory_st_ with 31 or 33 body characters, or with a '-' or '_' in the body.
twins.reason: Violates the exact length and alphabet of the generator.

twins.description: ory_at_ with a 42-byte key part, a 42- or 44-byte signature, no '.', two '.', or a '+' or '/' in the body.
twins.reason: Breaks the Hydra HMAC grammar; a third dot-separated segment is a JWT, not this token.

twins.description: ORY_ST_ uppercase, or a leading or trailing glue byte around an otherwise valid body.
twins.reason: The prefix is case-sensitive and the boundary rule rejects glued runs.

twins.description: ory_kratos_session and ory_session_ cookie names, ory_st_ placeholders shorter than 32, an ory_pat_ placeholder, and ORY_SESSION_TOKEN=${ORY_SESSION_TOKEN}.
twins.reason: Names and references, not token values.

twins.description: A JWT whose payload merely mentions ory_at_.
twins.reason: The jwt detector owns it; ory-token must not claim a substring of a JWT.

tradeoffs.falsePositive: An unrelated run matching ory_(st|at|rt|ac)_ plus the exact body grammar would be redacted; the exact lengths make this rare.
tradeoffs.falseNegative: Admin keys, JWT access tokens, custom prefixes and pre-2023 session tokens are not detected by this change.

limitations: Admin key body length and alphabet are not documented by any source
